messages:
maria: Heads up - support ticket #CS-9982 reporting API p99 latency spikes for customers hitting eu-west. Reports started ~09:10 UTC. Customers see TLS handshake timeouts and long tail >1.5s on initial connect.
ajay: seeing similar in synthetic probes - p95 normal, p99 up ~+800ms on TLS handshake. Only from a subset of EU PoPs.
eric: can you paste the probe logs? any DNS errors?
maria: pasted snippet from support: `curl -w '%{time_connect} %{time_starttransfer}\n' -o /dev/null -s https://api.redwood.example` -> `0.82 2.34` (weird: connect ~820ms then transfer after 2.34s)
samantha: that looks like TLS handshake stall rather than backend delay. traceroute shows cross-az hop bounce for some clients -> extra RTTs.
maria: @net-eng any recent BGP/anycast changes in EU?
net-eng: no config pushes this morning, but we did roll out an edge route tweak at 06:40 to move healthcheck traffic to a new POP cluster. Investigating if that impacted affinity.
ajay: I launched tcpdump on edge proxy in eu-west-2 for affected sessions. Observing SYN->SYN-ACK fine, but `ClientHello` retransmits and server replies delayed ~600-900ms intermittently.
eric: could be TLS offload overloaded or a kernel-level RST/requeue on that host. Check open file/socket counts and load.
sre-bot: deploy at 2026-03-15T06:40:12Z: edge-config-rollout eu-west:cluster-b -> cluster-c (success)
samantha: increase in socket waitqueuelen on cluster-c nodes.
maria: support wants a mitigation w/in 30m. Options: fail over traffic to healthy POPs, force session pinning to older cluster, or restart TLS worker processes. Thoughts?
ajay: immediate quick win: add routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 POPs for customers in that AS until rollback. We can do weighted routing and drain cluster-c.
eric: agree. Also enable TLS fallback to software path for a subset to validate hardware offload bug. Add a canary: 1% traffic via software offload and capture perf.
net-eng: can do weighted anycast tweak. I'll open change ticket and apply 10% shift now, monitor p99.
sre-bot: change-request CR-4521 created by net-eng.
maria: @support-ops please advise customers that we're investigating and applying temporary routing to reduce latency; ETA ~10-15m.
samantha: after 10% shift, internal probes p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 0.9s for affected flows. Good signal.
ajay: pushed to 50% now. Remaining spike likely tied to cluster-c TLS hardware offload.
net-eng: rolling back config to restore old affinity to cluster-b for new connections. Full rollback scheduled in 25m if stable.
eric: logged kernel and openssl versions, collecting stack traces. Filing an infra bug: INF-771, likely driver/firmware mismatch.
maria: checklist for post-mortem: timeline, root cause (route roll + offload perf), customer impact window, mitigation steps (routing weight, software fallback), long-term fix (firmware/drivers + canary before future edge rollout).
ajay: capturing PCAPs retained in S3: s3://redwood-debug/pcaps/2167890123/
sre-bot: alert cleared for eu-west TLS p99 at 09:55 UTC - metrics back to baseline.
maria: closing loop with support; will follow up with postmortem in #postmortems. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
net-eng: will schedule a firmware patch window and signoff on rollout safety checklist.
eric: remember to add an automated synthetic that validates full TLS handshake timing after future anycast changes.
maria: noted. I'll open the postmortem doc and include new test cases.
